`learning.pptx` is an original, non-sensitive three-slide Office Open XML deck
created with python-pptx for this feature. It contains titles, explanatory text,
and a colored shape. The browser tests exercise the real PPTX import and existing
reconstructed slide renderer, rather than supplying slide objects directly.
PDF browser fixtures are generated with pdf-lib and have three distinct pages.
AI answers are deterministic test responses; no live inference is asserted.
